latestVersion.changelog:
alibabacloud-odps-project-manage v0.0.2

- Added AI-Mode support: all workflows now require enabling/disabling AI-Mode and setting user-agent for commands.
- Updated all CLI instructions to require the specific user-agent "AlibabaCloud-Agent-Skills/alibabacloud-odps-project-manage".
- Removed project deletion capability (no longer supported; users are directed to console/administrator).
- Improved CLI version pre-check & installation guidance; referenced detailed install guide.
- Enhanced instructions for command validation and stricter parameter handling.
